description: Get the full public text of one Durability Curve essay as markdown. Its metadata carries the title, date and canonical field, and a link to the essay's claim ledger when it has one. For a paid essay only the free part is public, and the text says where it stops. When citing, link the canonical field in the response metadata. These tools retrieve The Durability Curve's public material. They do not certify that any claim is true.

slug.description: The essay's site or Substack slug (case-insensitive), or its full durabilitycurve.com/blog/ or harryfloyd.substack.com/p/ URL.

name: get_essay
title: Get an essay
